observations.statement: Resolved all 73 authorized own-arm validation receipts: 69 successful executions and four retained failures. Runtime history equals complete receipts; trajectory-index status, AUC and wall time also agree. Every success has 3,234,051 validation impressions.

All four round23 exact-source replays succeed. The two magnitude sources/configurations match round22 schema2 magnitude; both none sources/configurations match round22 schema2 none. These are fixed declared seed42 repeats, not independent initializations.

Round23 magnitude_a minus none_a AUC is -0.000015516176626206857 and Logloss is +0.00004392994443661036. Magnitude_b minus none_b AUC is -0.0003020218322767887 and Logloss is +0.000015786835573683433. Both new specified implementations lose on both population metrics.

The three exact schema2 magnitude AUCs are 0.6149316420253298, 0.6150866723308610 and 0.6148001666752104. All are below none AUC 0.6151021885074872, and all have higher Logloss. Their descriptive same-seed AUC range is 0.0002865056556506; the range exceeds the historical round17 magnitude-minus-none gain of 0.0001774051692154. Different source strata are kept separate.

All 64 reported diagnostics, all 23 slice dictionaries and both population metrics match exactly across the three schema2 none runs. Inference timing varies. This establishes replay of exported summaries, not identity of all predictions or hidden execution state.

Within round23 magnitude_a versus magnitude_b, both initial input sketches, both initial parameter sketches and the initial logit sketch match, but both gradient sketches differ at call0: a=(348608439,67451110), b=(923651332,134029289). Parameter sketches and logit sketch still match at call1; gradient sketches differ there. Both parameter sketches and the logit sketch differ at call512, the next captured state. Do not infer the exact first parameter-update divergence between calls1 and512.

Round22 schema2 magnitude and round23 magnitude_b match all call0 sketches, then differ in gradient sketches at call1 despite matching input, parameter and logit sketches there. This comparison narrows the earliest recorded discrepancy to call1 for that pair. It does not establish exact common optimizer/RNG state or a hardware cause.

All six schema2 runs report compatibility_selftest_pass=1, initial_gate_pass=1, exact initial bits flags, zero gate-after/repeat-gradient relative discrepancy and zero repeated-gradient relative discrepancy at all five captured calls. Between-run gradient sketches can nevertheless differ. A same-graph within-run repeat check and a between-execution replay test have different scope.

Each schema2 run reports five captured calls0/1/512/8192/14660, 14,661 calls and 60,045,735 examples through the selected checkpoint. Magnitude inherited two-probe surrogate relative-error maxima remain approximately 1.56e-8 to1.71e-8; none reports zero. These are candidate-owned diagnostics, not independent training-trajectory certificates.

Static, simple history pooling and adapted target-aware history baselines have AUC0.6050036144838207,0.6102261137080656 and0.6133619861190683. Count correction harms both references; half correction helps pooled history and slightly harms target-aware history. These are successful executions with negative or mixed scientific outcomes.

Same-field products and aligned unit normalization improve historical matched local contrasts at seed42. Constant tangent and history-mean replacements nearly match full normalization, while crossed, identity-gradient, action-mean and some reassigned variants lose. None of those near matches proves event-specific or action-semantic necessity.

The half-scale AUC0.6151021885074872 reappears in its audit/loss-hook/objective-audit receipts and no-row-intervention bridges. Query-only and history-only half-scale variants are worse. This is measured local replacement evidence, not independent-seed or full optimizer equivalence.

Round17 original magnitude is the historical AUC maximum0.6152795936767026, but has slightly worse Logloss than none. The projection bridge has the best observed Logloss0.19649601237450445. Direction-only, rotated-allocation and uniform-energy implementations lose; round16 role-sum and round17 complete-row estimands differ.

Original magnitude source/config replays at rounds17,19 and22 yield different scores. Round19 common-state M17/M18 probes have near-repeat-floor gradient differences and zero sampled cross-source Adam-step differences as recorded in scoped analysis; they neither tested M versus N optimizer mediation nor explain complete-run drift.

All four round21 v1 trace attempts fail with RuntimeError: Trace v1 supports float32/64 only; preserve failure. Their validation and diagnostics are absent; failed parameter/train/memory fields remain null. Their wall times sum21.4754219353199seconds. Schema2 successes supersede a continuing compatibility block without identifying the original offending tensor.

The latest four successful jobs consume3106.948972195387 summed receipt wall seconds. Their parameter counts all equal17,130,275, with17,078,688 embedding and51,587 dense parameters. Matching capacity/data passes does not establish equal measured compute or an efficiency advantage.

Latest declared knowledge usage associates scoped memory and inherited DIN with the four executed IDs/hashes/statuses. CRAFT and UniDot are considered, with no implemented variants of their reported mechanisms. The execution provenance matches receipts; declared use is not causal knowledge-value evidence.
